About Zhui Lab

About the Lab

Zhui Lab is a design laboratory built on AI technology. Our day-to-day work is putting the exploratory power of generative AI into real brand, product, and content production: first we use AI to open up many directions in a short time, then designers review, correct, and refine draft by draft — until what remains is both right and beautiful.

We are a team of 2–10 people — designers, engineers, and content creators. Engineers maintain our generation pipelines and automation tools; designers hold the line on aesthetics and standards. Technology decides how fast we can move; design decides where we go.

We take on four kinds of work: brand & visual identity, product interface design, AI image & video content, and e-commerce & marketing visuals. Whatever the project size, deliverables include editable source files and supporting guidelines, so client teams can keep using the work long-term.

What We Do

Services

Brand & Visual Identity

Brand Identity

Building a brand from scratch, or refreshing an existing one. We use AI to explore many logo and visual-language directions in parallel, then converge on an identity system built to last: logo, color, typography, layout, and graphic language as one coherent system — not a single isolated image.

Best for: New brand launches, brand refreshes, and unifying product-line visuals.

Deliverables

  • Logo source files (vector & common formats)
  • Brand visual guidelines
  • Brand color, typography & graphic language system
  • Templates for business cards, posters & everyday materials

Product UI Design

Product UI / UX

Interface design for websites and apps. We start with AI-assisted information architecture and layout exploration, then UI designers refine screen by screen, delivering complete files with a component library and design system — so development can build directly from the designs and future iterations stay consistent.

Best for: New product interfaces, product redesigns, and design system setup.

Deliverables

  • High-fidelity interface designs
  • Component library & design system documentation
  • Interaction notes for key flows
  • Developer handoff specs & export assets

AI Image & Video Content

AI Visual Content

This is the lab's specialty: producing image and short-video content with generative AI, through our own end-to-end pipeline — from concept and storyboards to final polish. Characters, scenes, and style stay consistent across an entire batch; it's a controlled process, not a lottery.

Best for: Short-form video, ad creative, character & world design, and batch visual production.

Deliverables

  • Final cuts & high-resolution source files
  • Storyboards & concept sheets
  • Prompt & generation parameter records
  • Versions adapted to multiple platform sizes

E-commerce & Marketing Visuals

E-commerce & Marketing

Product visuals and marketing materials. We use AI scene generation to replace part of traditional set-building and photography, quickly producing product imagery, campaign key visuals, and social content — then designers unify retouching and layout so the whole batch meets one visual standard.

Best for: E-commerce launches, marketing campaigns, and social content programs.

Deliverables

  • Product hero images & detail-page visuals
  • Campaign key visuals (KV) & extensions
  • Social media content template sets
  • Batch size & channel adaptations

Selected Work

Selected Work
Brand Identity

Geometric Identity System

Logo exploration and guidelines built from circles, arches, and triangles: AI first opens up dozens of construction directions, then we converge on one system that extends to cards, posters, and packaging.

UI Design

Cross-Platform Component Library

One design language across desktop and mobile: components, states, and data charts fully standardized, with designs mapped one-to-one to developer specs.

AI Video

Storyboards to Final Cut

Our workflow from static storyboards to finished video: pacing and motion are locked at the storyboard stage, then generation and frame-by-frame refinement follow — so the final cut is never left to chance.

E-commerce

Product Scene Visuals

Product display scenes built with AI scene generation: product, set, and lighting produced in batches under one visual standard, adapted for hero images, detail pages, and social channels.

The pieces above are showcase work for each of the lab's service areas, presenting the visual language and delivery formats we actually use.

How We Work

How We Work
01

Brief & Confirmation

Use the brief tool below or email us your needs. We reply to confirm scope, deliverables, and schedule — and we start once we're aligned.

02

Direction Exploration

We use AI to quickly generate concept drafts in several visual directions and review them with you to choose the one worth developing — so no time is wasted going the wrong way.

03

Refinement & Finalization

Designers refine the chosen direction draft by draft — composition, color, typography, and details — through the agreed rounds of revisions to a final version.

04

Delivery & Support

Source files, guidelines, and parameter records are packaged and delivered together. After delivery we keep a Q&A window open to help your team put the work to use.
